storage_driver.description: Storage driver used for image and container layers. Common values: overlay, vfs, btrfs, zfs.

storage_config_path.description: Path to the directory where Podman stores image layers, containers, and volumes.

default_runtime.description: Default OCI runtime used to launch containers (e.g., runc, crun).

systemd_cgroup.description: Enable systemd-managed cgroups for containers (required for systemd-based services).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level for Podman operations.

cni_config_file.description: Optional path to a custom CNI network configuration file or directory (leave blank for default).

registries.description: List of registries to search when pulling images.

insecure.description: Allow connecting to this registry over HTTP (not HTTPS).

blocked.description: Block pulling images from this registry.

prefix.description: Optional prefix for image name rewriting (e.g., 'library/' for docker.io).

default_namespace.description: Default image namespace to use if none is specified (e.g., 'library').

default_tag.description: Default tag to apply if none is specified.

runtimes.description: Named runtime definitions (e.g., for alternative runtimes like 'kata', 'gvisor').

path.description: Absolute path to the OCI runtime binary.

args.description: Optional list of arguments passed to the runtime.

selinux_enabled.description: Enable SELinux support for containers (Linux only).

default_volumes.description: Named volume mounts to attach by default to new containers.

env.description: Key-value pairs of environment variables automatically added to all containers.

hooks.description: Hooks to run before container start or after container stop.

args.description: Arguments passed to the hook script.

dns.description: List of DNS server IPs to configure inside containers.

userns_mode.description: User namespace mode for rootless containers (e.g., 'auto', 'host', 'auto:1000:1').
